row.name: Over the Rainbow Day Care Center

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director was missing annual training on the following topics:    Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction; and     Understanding building and physical premises safety, including identification and protection from hazards that can cause bodily injury such as electrical hazards, bodies of water, and vehicular traffic.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The director did not have current training in Transportation safety. The certificate available for review had a date of completion of 2/6/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The first aid kit in the transportation vehicle was incomplete. The items missing were tweezers and waterproof, disposable gloves.    Note: This was CORRECTED during inspection as the missing items were obtained and included in the first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands: A caregiver did not wash an infant's hands after a diaper change.       Note: This was addressed during inspection and caregiver proceeded to wash the infant's hands
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands (26 TAC §746.3505(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Six pedals were missing from a children's merry-go-cyle in the outdoor playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: A caregiver who conducts transportation did not have current training in transportation safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: 1 of 6 children records reviewed was missing the statement of the child's health from a health-care professional.
Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: There were no time sheets available for review for the director.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Vehicle Documentation - date of lease or purchase for each vehicle: There was no vehicle documentation to show the date of lease/purchase for the transportation vehicle requiring a child safety alarm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Vehicle Documentation - date of lease or purchase for each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5627)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The outdoor play area was observed with trash (plastic wrappers.) and big rocks.      Corrected at Inspection: The outdoor play area was cleaned during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One child's record review did not have a health statement on file.

Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: The director and 3 caregivers did not have the following required annual training hours:     -Child maltreatment   -Emergency preparedness;   -Administering medication,   -Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction   -Understanding building and physical premises safety, including identification and protection from hazards that can cause bodily injury such as electrical hazards, bodies of water, and vehicular traffic and   -Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Training Hours: Director did not have training records available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: The Infant Caregivers did not have the following annual training topics:   (1)  Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome and abusive head trauma; (2)  Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS); and (3)  Understanding early childhood brain development.    The person in charge of transportation did not have a transportation training in the file for review.     A caregiver hired on 12/16/19 did not have Pre-Service training certificate in the file.     Several training certificates did not have an assessment tool to show the knowledge acquired from the trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Sitting): A 4 seat Spring Rider did not have the required use zone area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Sitting) (26 TAC §746.4813(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The Spring Rider and Circle Cycle structure were observed with rusted area.     There was an unused water heater outside in the outdoor play area.     There was grass growing from the mulch. There was no mark for the mulch to indicate the depth of the surfacing material.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
